harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أنْ يُتْرَكُوا» stands in place of the two objects of حسب, and the interpreted maṣdar «أن يقولوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition (the lām). The clause «وهم لا يفتنون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The clause «ولقد فَتَنَّا», together with the implied oath, is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the initial clause {أَحَسِبَ النَّاسُ}, and the clause «فليعلمنَّ» is conjoined to the response to the oath «لقد فتنَّا».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «أم» is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) one, for digression (iḍrāb). «أنْ» and what follows it are equivalent to a maṣdar that stands in place of the two objects of حسب. «ما» is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent). The one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. "their judgement". The clause «ساء ما يحكمون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: «مَنْ»: conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «كان» is the khabar (predicate). The clause «وهو السميع» is resumptive, and «العليم» is a second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The preposition «عن العالمين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «غني».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «لنكفرنَّ» is the response to the oath, and the oath clause with its response is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين». «أحسن»: second object. «الذي»: a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The clause «ووصينا» is resumptive. «حسنًا»: stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), its adjective standing in for it, i.e. "an enjoining possessing goodness". «ما»: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The preposition «به» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «علم». The clause «إليَّ مرجعكم» is resumptive, and the clause «فأنبئكم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «إليَّ مرجعكم».

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «والذين آمنوا ...» is resumptive, and the clause «لندخلنهم» is the response to the oath; the oath and its response are the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject).

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «ومن الناس مَن» is resumptive, and the conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive one. The preposition «كعذاب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object. The clause «ولئن جاء» is conjoined to the conditional clause. His words «ليقولُن»: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, which was omitted because of the succession of similar letters; the wāw of the plural, omitted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, is the fāʿil (agent), and the nūn is for emphasis. The clause «أوليس الله بأعلم» is resumptive, and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate) of laysa. The preposition «بما» is attached to «أعلم», and the preposition «في صدور» is attached to the implied ṣila (relative clause).

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «ولنحمل» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause «وما هم بحاملين» is parenthetical. «ما» operates like laysa, and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate) of «ما». The preposition «من خطاياهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «شيء», and «شيء» is the object of «حاملين», and «مِنْ» is redundant. The clause «إنهم لكاذبون» is resumptive, in the context of the parenthesis.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «وليحملن» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding clause «قال الذين». His words «وليحملن» are like {لَيَقُولُنَّ} in verse (10), and likewise «وليسألُن». The preposition «عمَّا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يسألن».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «ولقد أرسلنا نوحًا» is resumptive, and the clause (لقد أرسلنا) is the response to the oath. The clause «فأخذهم الطوفان» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to something implied, i.e. "so they denied him, and it seized them". The clause «وهم ظالمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial). His words «ألف»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «لبث». «خمسين»: the excepted, accusative with yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The clause «فأنجيناه» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أخذهم», and «أصحاب» is a noun conjoined to the hāʾ in «أنجيناه». The preposition «للعالمين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective (ṣifa) of «آية».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: His words «وإبراهيم»: the wāw is a conjunction, and a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to {نُوحًا} in verse (14). «إذ»: an adverbial noun, badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) from «إبراهيم». The clause «ذلكم خير» is resumptive, and the clause «إن كنتم تعلمون» is resumptive; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أوثانا», and the preposition «لكم» is attached to a ḥāl from «رزقا». The clause «فابتغوا» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «إليه ترجعون».

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The preposition «من قبلكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «أمم». The clause «وما على الرسول إلا البلاغ» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «فقد كذَّب أمم». «البلاغ»: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition «على الرسول» is attached to the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «أولم يروا» is resumptive, and the clause «كيف يُبدئ» is the object of the seeing, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative; «كيف» is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). The preposition «على الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يسير», and the clause «إن ذلك على الله يسير» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «كيف بدأ» is the object of the looking, which carries the meaning of knowing and is suspended (muʿallaq) from governing; «كيف» is an interrogative noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial). «ثم» is resumptive, and the clause «ثم الله ينشئ» is resumptive. «ثم» is not a conjunction but a particle of resumption, because the second creation has not yet occurred and so does not fall under the demand for acknowledgement.

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The clause «يعذب» is a second khabar (predicate) of the preceding {إِنَّ}, and the clause «تُقلبون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يُعذب».

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The clause «ما أنتم بمعجزين» is resumptive, and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate) of «ما», which operates like laysa. The clause «وما لكم من دون الله من ولي» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive one. The preposition «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of «ولي»; «من» is redundant and «ولي» is the mubtadaʾ (subject). The preposition «من دون» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «وليّ».

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The clause «والذين كفروا ...» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {وَمَا أَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِينَ}. The clause «أولئك يئسوا» is the khabar (predicate) of الذين, and the clause «لهم عذاب» is the khabar of «أولئك».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «فما كان جواب قومه» is resumptive. The maṣdar «أن قالوا» is the ism (subject) of kāna, and «أنْ» is maṣdariyya. The clause «فأنجاه الله» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «قالوا». The clause «يؤمنون» is a naʿt (adjective) of قوم, and the preposition «لقوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt of «آيات»; the lām in «لآيات» is for emphasis.

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: «إنما»: the restraining (kāffa) and the restrained (makfūfa), having no governing effect. The preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object, and «أوثانًا» is the first object. «مودة»: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). The preposition «في الحياة» is attached to «اتخذتم». «يوم» is attached to «يكفر». The clause «يكفر» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «اتخذتم», and the clause «ومأواكم النار» is conjoined to the clause «إنما اتخذتم». His words «ناصرين»: mubtadaʾ (subject), «من» is redundant (zāʾida), and the preposition «لكم» is attached to the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The clause «فآمن له لوط» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding clause «قال». The clause «وقال إني مهاجر» is resumptive, and the clause «إنه هو العزيز» is resumptive. «هو»: tawkīd (emphasis) of the hāʾ in «إنه». «الحكيم»: second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The preposition «في ذريته» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object. The clause «وإنه في الآخرة ...» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «آتيناه». The preposition «في الآخرة» is attached to «الصالحين»; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the second preposition is attached to the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: His words «ولوطًا»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «إبراهيم» in verse (16). «إذ»: an adverbial noun, badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) from «لوطًا». The clause «ما سبقكم بها من أحد» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الفاحشة»; «أحد» is the fāʿil (agent), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The preposition «من العالمين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «أحد».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The clause «أإنكم لتأتون» is a badal (substitute) from «إنكم لتأتون». The clause «فما كان» is resumptive, and the maṣdar «أن قالوا» is the ism (subject) of kāna, placed later. The clause «إن كنت من الصادقين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. The preposition «بالبشرى» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جاءت». The clause «إن أهلها كانوا» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech.

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The preposition «بمن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعلم», and the preposition «فيها» is attached to the implied ṣila (relative clause). The clause «لننجينَّه» is the response to the oath, and the oath clause with its response is resumptive, within the scope of the speech. «أهله» is a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the hāʾ. The clause «كانت» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «امرأته».

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. «أن» is redundant (zāʾida). «ذرعًا»: tamyīz (specification). The clause «إنا منجُّوك» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech. His words «وأهلك»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "and We will save your family". The clause «كانت من الغابرين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «امرأتك».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The clause «إنَّا مُنزلون» is resumptive, within the scope of the speech. «رجزًا»: the object of «مُنزلون». The preposition «من السماء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رجزًا». «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the genitive interpreted maṣdar is attached to «مُنزلون».

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The oath clause with its response is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {إِنَّا مُنْزِلُونَ}. The preposition «لقوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تركنا».

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The wāw is resumptive. The preposition «إلى مدين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied (muqaddar) «أرسلنا», and «أخاهم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the implied verb. «شعيبًا»: badal (substitute). The clause «فقال» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the implied one. «مفسدين»: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «تعثوا».

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The clause «فكذَّبوه» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding clause «قال». The preposition «في دارهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جاثمين».

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: His words «وعادًا»: the wāw is a conjunction, and «عادًا» is the object of an implied «أهلكنا»; the clause "وأهلكنا" is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أرسلنا» that precedes in verse (36). The wāw in (وقد) is parenthetical, and the clause «وقد تبيَّن» is parenthetical between the two conjoined items. The fāʿil (agent) of «تبيَّن» is unexpressed, i.e. "what befell them", and the two prepositions «لكم» and «من مساكنهم» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تبيَّن». The clause «وزيَّن لهم الشيطان» is conjoined to the implied clause "أهلكنا", so that He will have reported several reports: the sending of Shuʿayb, the destruction of ʿĀd and Thamūd, and Satan's adorning for them. The clause «وكانوا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «صدَّهم».

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: His words «وقارون»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «ثمود». The clause «ولقد جاءهم» is resumptive. The preposition «بالبينات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاءهم.

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: His words «فكُلا»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «كلا» is an object placed first. The clause «أخذنا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding clause «استكبروا», and the clause «فمنهم من أرسلنا» is conjoined to the clause «أخذنا»; «مَنْ» is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «وما كان الله» is conjoined to the clause «ومنهم مَنْ أغرقنا», and the lām is that of denial (lām al-juḥūd); the interpreted maṣdar after it is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of kāna, implied as "intending wrongdoing". The clause «ولكن كانوا» is conjoined to the clause «ما كان الله». His words «أنفسهم»: an object of «يظلمون» placed first, and the clause «يظلمون» is the khabar of kāna.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object, and «أولياء» is the first object. The preposition «كمثل» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «اتخذت» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «العنكبوت». The clause «وإن أوهن ...» is resumptive, and the conditional clause is resumptive; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "they would not have worshipped the idols".

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: «ما» is negating, and the clause «ما يدعون» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb of knowing, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the negation. The preposition «من دونه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «شيء»; «شيء» is a mafʿūl bihi, and «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida), as though it were said: "they do not call upon, besides Him, anything that deserves to be called a thing". The clause «وهو العزيز» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «إن الله يعلم».

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The clause «وتلك الأمثال» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding clause {مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ}. The clause «نضربها» is the khabar (predicate). The clause «وما يعقلها إلا العالمون» is conjoined to the clause «نضربها»; «العالمون» is the fāʿil (agent), and «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr).

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The preposition «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the Divine Name, and the preposition «للمؤمنين» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of آية.

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The preposition «من الكتاب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «أُوحي». The wāw in «ولَذِكْر» is resumptive and the lām is that of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ). The clause «والله يعلم» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: The clause «ولا تجادلوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding clause {اتْلُ}. «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr). The preposition «بالتي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تجادلوا». The preposition «منهم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «ظلموا». The clause «وإلهنا وإلهكم واحد» is conjoined to the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl), and likewise the clause «ونحن له مسلمون».

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The wāw is resumptive, and the kāf is a stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "We sent down the Book with a sending-down like that sending-down". The clause «فالذين آتيناهم ...» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive «أنزلنا», and the clause «ومِنْ هؤلاء مَنْ يؤمن» is conjoined to the clause «الذين آتيناهم». The clause «وما يجحد» is parenthetical between the two conjoined items.

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: The clause «وما كنت» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {أَنْزَلْنَا}; «كتاب» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «لارتاب المبطلون» is the apodosis of a condition implied with لو, i.e. "had you been reciting, the falsifiers would have doubted".

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The clause «بل هو آيات» is resumptive. The preposition «في صدور» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second naʿt (adjective) of «آيات». The clause «وما يجحد ...» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «هو آيات»; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and «الظالمون» is the fāʿil (agent) of «يجحد».

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The clause «وقالوا» is resumptive. «لولا»: a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). The preposition «من ربه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of آيات.

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The clause «أولم يكفهم» is resumptive, and the interpreted maṣdar «أنَّا أنزلنا» is the fāʿil (agent) of «يكفي». The clause «يتلى» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الكتاب». The preposition «لقوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ذكرى», and the clause «يؤمنون» is a naʿt of «قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the fāʿil (agent) of «كفى». The adverb «بيني» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شهيدًا», and «شهيدًا» is a tamyīz (specification). The clause «يعلم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the Divine Name. The clause «والذين آمنوا ...» is resumptive, and the clause «أولئك هم الخاسرون» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين». «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: The clause «ويستعجلونك» is resumptive, and the conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive one. «أجلٌ»: mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "existing". The clause «ليأتينَّهم» is the response to the oath, and the oath with its response is a resumptive clause. «بغتة» is a maṣdar in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause «وهم لا يشعرون» is a ḥāl.

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: The clause «يستعجلونك» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «وإن جهنم لمحيطة»; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the preposition «بالكافرين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «محيطة».

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: (يوم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «محيطة», and the clause «يغشاهم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «ويقول» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يغشاهم».

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: «الذين»: naʿt (adjective). «إياي»: a detached accusative pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb explained by what follows it. The first fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «إن أرضي واسعة»; the second fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and the clause «اعبدون» is explicative.

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: The clause «ترجعون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding resumptive one, and the preposition «إلينا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ترجعون».

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: The clause «لنبوئنهم» is the response to the oath, and the oath with its response is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين». «غرفًا»: second object. The preposition «من الجنة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «غُرفًا», and the clause «تجري» is a naʿt (adjective). «خالدين»: ḥāl from the object of «نبوئنهم». The clause «نعم أجر» is resumptive, and the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted, i.e. "Paradise".

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: «الذين»: naʿt (adjective) of العاملين. The preposition «على ربهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يتوكلون».

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: The wāw is resumptive. «كأين»: a noun alluding to a number (ism kināya), mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كأين». The clause «لا تحمل» is a naʿt of «دابة», and the clause «الله يرزقها» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «كأين». His words «وإياكم»: a detached accusative pronoun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the hāʾ. The clause «وهو السميع» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: The clause «ولئن سألتهم» is resumptive, and the clause «من خلق» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the asking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative. The lām in «ليقولن» occurs in the response to the oath. «يقولُن»: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, which was omitted because of the succession of similar letters; the wāw, omitted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, is the fāʿil (agent). «الله»: fāʿil of an omitted verb, i.e. "Allah created them". The clause «فأنى يؤفكون» is resumptive, and «أنى» is an interrogative noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «ليقولُنَّ» is the response to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: The preposition «من عباده» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun.

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: The clause «ولئن سألتهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «لئن سألتهم» in verse (61), and the clause «مَنْ نزل» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the asking, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative. His words «الله»: fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "Allah sent it down". The clause «بل أكثرهم لا يعقلون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: «ما»: negating and inoperative (muhmala). The clause «لهي الحيوان» is the khabar (predicate), and the clause «لو كانوا يعلمون» is resumptive; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "they would not have preferred the life of this world".

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. «الدين»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «مخلصين». The second conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «دعوا». «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya), and the clause «إذا هم يشركون» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: The lām in «ليكفروا» is that of outcome (lām al-ʿāqiba), and the genitive maṣdar is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {يُشْرِكُونَ}. The clause «فسوف يعلمون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: The clause «أولم يروا» is resumptive, and the maṣdar is the object of «يَرَوا». The clause «ويُتخطف الناس» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «يروا». The clause «يؤمنون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أولم يروا».

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: The clause «ومن أظلم» is resumptive, and the clause «لما جاءه» is resumptive; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The preposition «للكافرين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «مثوى».

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: The clause «والذين جاهدوا ...» is resumptive, and the clause «لنهدينهم» is the response to the oath; the oath with its response is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين». «سبلنا»: second object. The clause «وإن الله لمع المحسنين» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive one.
